snippet.title: Retrolix1
snippet.description:
Retrolix brings the overlooked objects of the past back into focus — familiar gadgets, vintage toys, unusual mechanisms, and curious designs that once felt completely ordinary.

Our channel explores things people used, collected, carried, or kept around the house — from clever mechanical devices and early electronics to forgotten tools and everyday objects that gradually disappeared. Some are instantly recognizable. Others seem surprisingly strange by modern standards.

Each video combines original research, written context, and carefully structured editing to explain what the object was, how it worked, and what made it worth remembering. The goal is not simply to show something old, but to reveal the ideas, details, and stories hidden inside it. 

Welcome to the place made for anyone who enjoys rediscovering forgotten objects, unusual inventions, and pieces of everyday history from another era.

snippet.title: DropForgedSurvival
snippet.description:
Survival • Bushcraft • Primitive Skills • EDC • Prepping • Camping • Faith | Texas
We Focus On Survival & Outdoor skills, blending primitive technology, modern gear, and faith in Jesus Christ to build true self-reliance in both the urban environment & the Wilderness.
Based in Texas, I document hands-on experiences in wilderness survival, bushcraft, primitive skills, camping, EDC (Everyday Carry), prepping, and long-term survival challenges. From fire starting and shelter building to modern survival gear, tools, and power stations—everything is field tested in real conditions.
I’m a full-time YouTube creator, outdoorsman, father, and disciple of Christ committed to learning and teaching others. From overnighters to extreme 7–30 day survival challenges, I share real lessons—because preparedness comes from doing, not theory.

📧 Sponsorships
Brands seeking authentic testing of EDC equipment, Tools, outdoor tech, or camping products contact us via email.

snippet.title: contra1981
snippet.description:
This page exists for education.

Contra1981 focuses on practical preparedness, emergency communication tools, and self-reliance skills that apply to everyday life — explained clearly, calmly, and responsibly.

The goal here is simple:
	•	Help people understand how off-grid and backup communication works
	•	Share practical knowledge about preparedness tools and systems
	•	Encourage thoughtful planning, not fear or panic
	•	Promote responsible, lawful, and safe use of equipment

This is not about hype, fear, or extreme scenarios.
It’s about understanding how things work before you need them.

Everything shared here is intended for informational and educational purposes only. Viewers are encouraged to do their own research, follow local laws, and use good judgment.

If you’re here to learn, ask questions, and build real-world knowledge — you’re in the right place.

— Contra1981

snippet.title: Jessica L.
snippet.description:
Hello! My name's Jessica!

I'm a 30 something year old mom/wife in the NC Triangle who started "grown up" life a little early, and am just trying to navigate through it whilst toting around two kids, my cutest accessories.

I like to blog/vlog about a variety of things but a majority of my posts and videos are about fashion and makeup, (So original, I know).

I started my blog Linn Style, (my attempt to be punny), to connect with other women of all ages and life stages to form a community where we can all come together to experience life and swap fashion, beauty, and life experiences and tips with each other!  Now I'm exploring the world of Youtube, so join me on this journey!

Enjoy!

~Jessica Linn

Disclaimer: I use affiliate links which means if you purchase through it I may get a commission but at no extra charge to you!

snippet.title: Eli Yoder Secrets
snippet.description:
For generations, Amish communities across Pennsylvania and Ohio have lived without energy bills, without pesticides, and without depending on systems most people can't imagine living without.

📄How to Cut Every Household Bill to Zero:  https://eliyodersecrets.com/

The Amish have never paid a utility bill — here is the exact system, 
step-by-step, for any home you already own.

We just knew things. 

This channel is a record of those methods — the ones that were quietly removed from mainstream knowledge, the ones that still work today, and the ones that nobody is talking about.

New video every day. 

Subscribe if you want to know what they don't teach anymore.

The Amish communities I'm talking about are the traditional Old Order communities of Lancaster and Holmes County — not all Amish are the same, and some have adopted modern tools.

snippet.title: Osteoporosis Canada
snippet.description:
Osteoporosis Canada is the only national organization serving people affected by osteoporosis. The organization works to educate, empower and support individuals and communities on bone and muscle health and in the risk-reduction and treatment of osteoporosis with a renewed focus on reducing fragility fractures.

We were the world’s first organization dedicated to osteoporosis, the first to establish guidelines for long-term treatment and exercise, and the first to introduce fracture risk assessment.

With your help, we teach Canadians how to optimize their bone and muscle health. We support those already diagnosed, and work to improve their quality of life. And we pursue research and treatment breakthroughs that keep more people healthy.

Together, we will make Canadians unbreakable.

https://www.osteoporosis.ca

snippet.title: Cecilia Blomdahl
snippet.description:
I live on Svalbard, an island close to the North Pole!

My name is Cecilia, I’m from Sweden, and I’ve called Svalbard home for over a decade. I live in a cabin outside Longyearbyen with Christoffer and my dog Grim, and I make videos about our life here.

Svalbard is a pretty unusual place to call home, and on my channel I take you along for what life looks like in the World’s Northernmost town. From the extreme seasons of Polar Night and Midnight Sun to regular life at our cabin and the more unusual realities of living this far north (yes, that includes watching out for polar bears 🐻‍❄️).

📚 You can also check out my New York Times bestselling books, Life on Svalbard and The Polar Night Adventure!

📮 Want to send us something?
Cecilia Blomdahl
PB 58
9171 Longyearbyen
Svalbard & Jan Mayen
NORWAY

snippet.title: Maurice Moves
snippet.description:
Hey there! 👋 I’m Maurice, and every video I make revolves around one belief: that the most important things for us to pay attention to are the things we do and use every single day.

What I mean is, we’re conditioned to prioritize and focus on life’s “exclamation marks” - the new car, the big vacation, the wedding day, the career change - but the truest way to have the biggest impact on our lives is how we write the sentences between those exclamation points - the regular everyday tools, habits, and actions we use day-in-day-out that enable those exclamation marks in the first place.

Because of this, my videos typically fall into three categories:

• Everyday Carry (EDC)
• Everyday Habits (Health & Productivity)
• Everyday Growth (Entrepreneurship & Exploration)

Thanks for spending some of your time with me - I hope you’ll keep visiting when you can!

👆(written in Toronto 🇨🇦 on August 21, 2022)🖋

📸 @MauriceMoves

snippet.title: Case Trace
snippet.description:
Case Trace Society follows missing persons and unresolved cases across the US.

Each video traces the last known timeline of a case using publicly available information… until it stops.

We focus on what is confirmed, what remains unclear, and where the timeline breaks—without speculation or assumption.

This channel is intended for informational and awareness purposes only. Details may change as investigations continue.

If you have information related to any case featured, please contact the appropriate authorities listed in each video.

Because sometimes, the smallest detail is the one that changes everything.

#Tennessee #MissingTeen #StillMissing #NoTrace
